meta.name: notebooklm
meta.description: Install, authenticate, troubleshoot, and operate Gemini Notebook through the notebooklm-py CLI or typed async Python API. Use for notebook and source management, grounded chat and research, and artifact generation or download when the user mentions Gemini Notebook, notebooklm-py, the notebooklm CLI, or its Python API. Do not use for the generic Gemini API or unrelated content creation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把自备资料变成可对话的调研助手
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有成堆资料想让 AI 直接作答并归纳要点
copy.tagline_en: Turn your documents into a Q&A research assistant
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have many source documents and want AI to answer and summarize from them

howto.what: Claude 会调用你本机的 notebooklm 命令，帮你完成 Gemini Notebook 的登录检查、创建笔记本、添加资料并等待就绪、在线提问、发起研究，以及生成并下载音频、思维导图等作品。
howto.when: 当你说到 Gemini Notebook、notebooklm 或它的 Python API，并要求做资料问答、做研究或生成作品时触发；不处理通用 Gemini API。

say.text: 帮我把这个链接加进我的笔记本，并等它处理完。
say.note: 会执行 source add 与 source wait。

say.text: 检查我的 notebooklm 认证是否有效。
say.note: 会运行 auth check --test 并汇报结果。

say.text: 给当前笔记本的资料生成一个思维导图。
say.note: 会触发 generate mind-map 并直接返回结果。

howto.what_en: Claude will use your local notebooklm command to check Gemini Notebook login, create notebooks, add sources and wait until ready, answer grounded questions, run research, and generate or download outputs such as audio, video, quizzes, and mind maps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Gemini Notebook, notebooklm, or its Python API and want grounded chat, research, or artifact generation. Not for the generic Gemini API or unrelated creation.

say_en.text: Add this link to my notebook and wait until it's ready.
say_en.note: Runs source add and source wait.

say_en.text: Check whether my notebooklm login still works.
say_en.note: Runs auth check --test and reports the result.

say_en.text: Generate a mind map from this notebook's sources.
say_en.note: Triggers generate mind-map and returns the completed result.
